backend_issues.notes: All 7 backend tests passing. Contact request API working perfectly with idempotency, validation, and email delivery.

critical_bugs.issue: Cart state does not persist across page navigations
critical_bugs.reproduction: Add item to cart on PDP -> navigate to /teileklar/warenkorb directly -> cart is empty. BUT clicking 'Zum Warenkorb' link from success message shows cart with items.
critical_bugs.impact: Users cannot complete checkout flow. Cart appears empty when navigating to /teileklar/kasse directly.
critical_bugs.root_cause: Cart state likely stored in client-side state only, not persisting to backend or cookies properly across page loads
critical_bugs.test_evidence: Cart shows 2 items when accessed via link from PDP success message, but shows empty when accessed via direct URL navigation

critical_bugs.issue: Product links in catalog do not navigate to product detail pages
critical_bugs.reproduction: Go to /teileklar/shop -> click on any product card link -> stays on /teileklar/shop, does not navigate to /teileklar/produkt/[id]
critical_bugs.impact: Users cannot browse products from catalog. Must use direct URLs.
critical_bugs.root_cause: Product links have correct href but click event is being prevented or not handled by Router
critical_bugs.test_evidence: Found 24 product links with correct hrefs, but clicking does not trigger navigation

critical_bugs.issue: Locale dropdown changes value but page doesn't reload or update URL
critical_bugs.reproduction: Go to /leistungen/websites?lang=en -> select 'de' from dropdown -> dropdown value changes to 'de' but URL stays ?lang=en and content remains in English
critical_bugs.impact: Users cannot switch languages via dropdown
critical_bugs.root_cause: window.location.assign() in onChange handler not executing or being prevented
critical_bugs.test_evidence: Dropdown value changed from 'en' to 'de' but URL, title, and html lang attribute unchanged. Same issue as iteration 22.

frontend_issues.notes: Product detail pages work perfectly when accessed directly. JSON-LD Product schema present and valid. Add to cart functionality works. Mobile responsive (390px no overflow). Desktop 1920x800 tested.
